nitroxanalyser.changelog: Faster B1 monochrome label printing and B1 Pro red/black printing on compatible 50 x 30 mm dual-colour stock. Adds saved label-stock modes and quiet background printer availability checks, avoiding repeated Printer not found screens when a printer is asleep. Existing licences, calibration and settings are retained by update-only installation.

divesoftadapter.changelog: Faster B1 monochrome printing and B1 Pro red/black printing on compatible 50 x 30 mm dual-colour stock. Adds a red HYPOXIC banner with calculated minimum depth at 0.18 bar ppO2, without overlapping the gas values. Improves startup/stay-connected behaviour with quiet printer availability checks. Nitrox labels remain free; Pro reveals the actual helium percentage.
